label: Congressional disclosure × federal money-stream crossings
question: Generalizing the OGE-FEC overlap engine to the full legislative cohort: which members' disclosed entities exactly overlap a federal money stream, and in what temporal order relative to their votes/tenure?

stages.label: Enumerate the members of Congress cohort (denominator)
search_templates: members of Congress roster official list term

stages.label: Resolve each member's disclosed business entities
Enumerate the federal spending (USAspending) money stream
search_templates: federal spending (USAspending) recipient award amount date

stages.label: Exact-name / entity overlap between entity set and money stream
Temporal screen: order of disclosure vs. award vs. tenure

denominator.definition: The full chamber roster for the term slice.
denominator.discipline: Every member enumerated; a null crossing is a recorded result.

source_adapters.note: Disclosure portals (Clerk/eFD) are viewer-only; ScreenGhost normalizes to entity rows.
Reuses the OGE-FEC overlap/temporal-screen logic; the join/screen is derivation-with-a-check (Sonnet).

epistemic_contract.forbidden_inference: A signature or crossing match never establishes coordination, influence, wrongdoing, or intent. Structural convergence on shared incentives is the null hypothesis; only document-level receipts can upgrade any candidate, and only a human reviewer can admit it.
epistemic_contract.coverage_honesty: not_searched is the honest default and may not cite executed searches. unavailable_after_search requires search provenance. A partial surface is never labeled complete; absence of evidence is a coverage result, not proof of absence.
epistemic_contract.denominator_discipline: Every score is over a declared, bounded universe. The denominator and its source are named; below-threshold members are retained, not dropped.

retrieval_tiering.principle: Tier-Bench H2: work separates on settled-vs-derived, not difficulty. That line IS the candidate_only boundary — retrieval has graph_effect none, so cheap models are both cost-optimal and epistemically safe there.

rungs.validation_surface: deterministic: fields present, receipt hashes, record parses
rungs.escalate_when: extraction fails its schema check or a hash mismatches

rungs.validation_surface: structured: join reconciles by exact key; temporal order well-defined and re-derivable
rungs.escalate_when: fuzzy/near match, competing entity, or undefined temporal order

rungs.note: Small, nameable, scarce. This is the only work retrieval may not do (graph_effect none).

retrieval_tiering.escalation: effort-first: start at the cheapest rung whose validation surface covers the op; escalate only on measured failure, never preemptively.
retrieval_tiering.measurement: cost_per_success = average_cost / success_rate, per adapter per tier (Tier-Bench).
retrieval_tiering.invariant: No operation that promotes candidate->finding runs below fable+human.

custody.note: Each confirmed crossing seals with disclosure + award receipts and the temporal screen.
custody.acceptance: A track corpus is custody-ready when every admitted candidate's receipts compile into a genesis shard that passes `axm-verify` DETACHED (bytes + out-of-band key only). Until then receipts remain receipt-v2 provenance, honestly labeled.
